Name: Moths (Butterfly Texture Swap for CP)
Author: CommanderCorvus
Description:
Replaces default butterflies with an assortment of moths (3 color variants of luna moth body type, 2 mottled brown moths, and a few darker-colored solid and gradient butterflies.)

Install Instructions:
Standard Content Patcher install, simply unzip the file into the Mods folder.

Notes: Replaces the entire "critters.xnb" file so may not be compatible with other texture swaps that edit that file without some extra editing. If I can figure out how to just replace the bits with the butterflies, I'll push an update.

Upcoming improvements: Adding update key, refactoring so that it'll only replace the butterflies instead of the entire critters.xnb (because i figured out how to do that :V)

Downloads.Description: Contains moth assets and required JSON files.
